A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a new concept of effective synaptic conductance to study the synaptic mechanisms underlying the neuronal computation and develop a framework for accurate determination of effective conductance.

the traditional method of measuring input conductance has a space clamp effect, and the effective conductance, which reflects directly the functional synaptic impact on neuronal computation, should be measured instead of the input conductance.

the conductance determined via the traditional method may be different from the local synaptic conductance on the neuron dendrites, and it may even have negative value, while the effective conductance determined by our proposed method reflects directly the functional impact of synaptic inputs on the neuron.
